summary: The candidate is correct. Assertion 1 follows from exact ordered same-parity midpoint counting, Cauchy-Schwarz, and the valid observation that any positive endpoint product forces the midpoint fiber to have positive volume. For assertion 2, the shear preserves all relevant structure and mixed fiber mass; the eroded symmetric body has centroid with zero lattice-coordinate component; Prékopa's theorem makes its continuous-section volume log-concave; the unimodular half-open tiling and closed erosion give the claimed exact endpoint implication; and the endpoint pairing combined with the log-concave Grünbaum inequality yields the stated V/(2e) bound. Proper, vertical, whole-space, positive-boundary-mass, and V=0 cases are all handled, and the final supremum and finiteness arguments are valid.
